snippet.title: KINETIC - RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Kinetic is a first-person platform game with smooth and responsive movements. It's all about optimizing trajectories, using momentum and portals to complete each level as quickly as possible.

You move through three different environments:
- The concrete dimension, with its standard first-person parkour moves.
- The ice dimension, which lets you glide at speed, much like you would on a skating rink. This dimension is inspired by Counter Strike's surf mode and Urban Terror's icy mode but is beginners friendly.
- The bounce dimension, which lets you bounce on any surface without losing momentum.

Once you've unlocked the dimensions, you'll be free to switch from one to the other whenever you like using the portal.

Each level has its own leaderboard, which stores the best times of all players. It also has a “friends” section so you can compare yourself only with them!

Finally, there is a global leaderboard that groups together all the times for all levels.

In a level, you can see other players trace by checking the box next to any player leaderboard entry.

GL HF

Trailer editing: Quentin Marty (https://veodali.weebly.com/)
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383350/Kinetic
